_readme: Cases the cloud suite can't run for real, and what covers them instead. Everything else in qa/antigravity/cases is either automated (a test carries its id) or not automated yet, and the daily report lists the P0 ones still missing. Remove an entry when a cloud test covers the case for real.

needsAPerson.GM-PERF-010: Battery drain over 8 hours needs real hardware; emulator battery stats aren't meaningful. In the cloud: GM-PERF-011 (polling slows down when idle) and GM-SVC-009 (Doze) show Guardian isn't keeping the phone awake.
needsAPerson.GM-PAUSE-010: The emulator can't place a call with caller ID hidden. In the cloud: core tests feed a null/blank number through screening and the tripwires and check it counts as unknown.
needsAPerson.GM-SCRN-013: Hidden, short-code and international caller IDs need a real carrier. In the cloud: core screening tests with blank, short and +44 numbers.
needsAPerson.GM-SCRN-014: Caller-ID verification (STIR/SHAKEN) can't be simulated on an emulator. In the cloud: core screening tests with verificationFailed = true.
needsAPerson.GM-HOME-003: Whether someone new to the app can call Sarah in under 5 seconds is a usability check. In the cloud: the device suite times tile tap to an outgoing call and checks the tile's spoken label.
needsAPerson.GM-A11Y-002: A full TalkBack walk-through is judged by a person. In the cloud: JVM tests check every parent control has a label, role and 48 dp target.
needsAPerson.GM-A11Y-008: Google's Accessibility Scanner is a Play Store app. In the cloud: the same checks as GM-A11Y-002.
needsAPerson.GM-RACC-016: Real AnyDesk needs a Google account on a Play Store image. In the cloud: the stand-in installs under AnyDesk's real package name.
needsAPerson.GM-CONS-012: "Restricted settings" for sideloaded apps only shows on Play Store images and real phones. Could move to the cloud with a google_apis_playstore emulator job.
needsAPerson.GM-SCAM-010: "Your own scenario" is exploratory by design. The daily review adds a new scripted scenario as a case whenever it finds a gap.
